question: An exponent of Hindustani classical music, Gangubai Hangal was an eminent singer to have hailed from the __ __ gharana of the Hindustani Khyal family.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kirana.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian vocalist **Gangubai Hangal **specialized in the **khayal style** of Hindustani classical music.
 
• She hails from **Karnataka** and was renowned for **her resonant voice.**
 
• Hangal was a member of the **Kirana gharana.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Patiala: **

 
 
• **Mian Kallu,** a sarangi player for the Jaipur durbar,** founded **the gharana somewhere between the **middle and end of the 19th century.**
 
 
 
• **Agra:**
 
 
• The **Nauhar Bani** is the ancestor of the Agra gharana, a school of **Hindustani classical vocal music.**
 
 
 
• **Gwalior:**
 
 
• One of the **oldest Khyal Gharanas **in Indian classical music is the Gwalior Gharana.
 
• The** Mughal emperor Akbar's rule **marked the beginning of the Gwalior Gharana's ascent.
